item.title: Veg, egg, chicken remain cheaper
item.description: Prices of most daily essentials remained largely unchanged in the capital's kitchen markets on Friday, with vegetables, eggs and chicken continuing their downward trend. While prices of new onions and potatoes edged down slightly, volatility in the old onion market has yet to ease.The picture of commodity prices was seen in various markets in the capital on Friday.Traders claimed that the prices in the wholesale market are now higher. item.title: State mourning being observed

item.title: BFF, BCB mourn death of Hadi
item.description: Bangladesh Football Federation (BFF) and Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) expressed deep shock and sorrow at the death of Inqilab Moncho spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi.BFF posted a picture of Hadi on its social media Facebook page on Thursday last night and wrote: "We are deeply saddened. item.title: Zubaida leaves Dhaka for London
item.description: Dr Zubaida Rahman, wife of BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman, left Dhaka for London on Saturday morning, spending nearly two weeks by the side of party Chairperson Begum Khaleda Zia.She departed around 8:48AM by a flight of Biman Bangladesh Airlines from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.This flight will reach London's Heathrow Airport directly via Sylhet.BNP Media Cell member Atiqur Rahman Rumon said, ''Dr Zubaida has returned to London. item.title: Arson attack on National Democratic Front president Anisul's house
item.description: Miscreants set the house of Barrister Anisul Islam Mahmud, president of National Democratic Front (NDF), on fire in Hathazari upazila of Chittagong district on Friday night.Witnesses said some unidentified people swooped on the ancestral home of Anisul around 11:40PM and carried out vandalism.Later, they exploded crude bombs and set the house on fire.Meanwhile, the miscreants also set a private vehicle, owned by Akbar Haidar Chowdhury, paternal uncle of the NDF leader, on fire.Getting informatio

item.title: Hadi's janaza: Addl police with around 1,000 body-worn cameras deployed
item.description: Adequatenumber of police and members of Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been deployed at key points in the capital to maintain law and order during Inquilab Moncho spokesperson Osman Hadi's namaz-e-janaza.DMP Deputy Commissioner (Media) Talebur Rahman said that an additional number of police personnel, equipped with around 1,000 body-worn cameras, have been deployed to ensure overall security and prevent any untoward incident.
